tei:respStmt.tei:name: Efraim Feinstein

tei:editionStmt.tei:edition: Read directly from the scanned 1949 printing, page by page

tei:body.tei:p: Have mercy, Lord our God, on Israel thy people, on Jerusalem thy city, on Zion the abode of thy majesty, on the royal house of David thy chosen one, and on the great and holy Temple that bears thy name. Our God, our Father, tend and nourish us; sustain and maintain us; grant us deliverance. Speedily, Lord our God, grant us relief from all our troubles. Lord our God, O make us not dependent on the gifts and loans of men but rather on thy full, open and generous hand, that we may never be put to shame and disgrace.
